title: Josh Allen on late TD to beat Texans: Sometimes the ball bounces your way

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Josh Allen on late TD to beat Texans: Sometimes the ball bounces your way
sources.description: It's hard to come up with too many examples of how thin the line between winning and losing can be than back-to-back plays that the Bills ran late in the fourth quarter in Houston on Sunday.
